text:
elaine: Quick design sync we're iterating on the notification matrix for alerts. Two calls: compact rows (density) and the collapsed-channel hover preview. Thoughts? marco: For compact rows I'd keep a single-line rule title + tiny status pill + 3-icon channel summary. No long copy. Users can expand for details. rita: accessibility concern: the three-icon summary needs descriptive alt text or an accessible label like 'sends to 3 channels: PagerDuty, #ops, email'. Screenreaders shouldn't just read 'icon icon icon'. ben: Agreed. Also want per-channel override affordance visible in collapsed state (like a tiny chevron and a badge "1 override"). Otherwise teams miss that an email has different escalation rules. elaine: UX ask: on hover of the collapsed group show a one-line mock notification (timestamp, level, brief body) instead of listing channels. That gives context quickly without expanding. marco: Nice. Keep it non-interrupting: subtle tooltip with max width, monospace for timestamp maybe. rita: Copy debate: label for suppression window. Options: 'Mute rule', 'Pause notifications', 'Snooze rule'. Which is clearest to customers? ben: "Pause notifications" felt the clearest in recent user tests. "Mute" was too final. "Snooze" implies a temporary burst but is ambiguous about scope (what is snoozed?). elaine: Let's standardize on 'Pause notifications' and add a short subtext: 'Rule-level pause; does not affect other rules or incident pages'. That should satisfy legal/PD. marco: Microcopy for thresholds: two-line compact vs expanded. Compact: 'Errors > 5% for 5m'. Expanded helper: 'Notify the team if error rate exceeds 5% for 5 consecutive minutes.' Keep readable. rita: Also propose adding a unit selector next to the duration (m / s / h) so translators have better context. And ensure the expanded copy respects locale formatting. ben: Visual contrast issue: severity pills (info/warn/critical) need >=4.5:1 text contrast on dark tokens. Current red on orange text fails. elaine: I'll file a brief with design tokens to increase contrast and show a before/after. marco: Keyboard nav: when focusing collapsed row, pressing right-arrow should reveal hover preview inline (not expand full) and Esc dismisses. That helps power users. rita: For screenreader notes: preview should be reachable via a 'Show sample' button with aria-expanded toggles. Tooltips are not reliably announced. ben: QA-bot note: regression test added to check collapsed preview exists and includes channel names and a sample message. qa-bot: test: collapsed_row_preview_renders -> PASS on feat/compact-matrix. elaine: dev impl status? marco: pushed a prototype in feat/compact-matrix: snippet for aria: ```html
Show sample
[sample notification]
``` ben: Please ensure the sample text uses aria-live when updated dynamically so screenreaders hear changes. rita: One more copy nit: replace 'channel summary' label with 'destinations' in UI copy to avoid Slack-specific wording. elaine: Good call. I'll update Figma and post links. We'll include a quick prototype video for the keyboard nav behavior. Thanks all.
